=== SKILL: Regression Testing Before Completion ===
---
name: Regression Testing Before Completion
description: Use when modifying existing code logic to ensure previous functionality remains intact before declaring the task complete.
---
- Identify the specific functions or modules being modified.
- Write or update regression tests that cover the existing behavior of the changed code.
- Execute the new tests to verify they pass with the current implementation.
- Confirm that the tests would fail if the original bug or regression were present.
- Only claim completion after all regression tests pass successfully.
=== END ===

=== SKILL: Verify Completion Criteria ===
---
name: Verify Completion Criteria
description: Use when finalizing a task to ensure all defined success conditions and quality gates are met before reporting completion.
---
1. Review the original task requirements and acceptance criteria.
2. Check if all mandatory validation steps have been executed.
3. Confirm that any required regression or verification tests have been added and passed.
4. Ensure no critical errors or warnings remain unresolved.
5. Only report completion after all checks are verified as successful.
=== END ===
